title: Your Group-Relative Advantage Is Biased
abstract: arXiv:2601.08521v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Verifier Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a widely used approach for post-training large language models on reasoning tasks, with group-based methods such as GRPO and its variants gaining broad adoption. These methods rely on group-relative advantage estimation to avoid learned critics, yet its theoretical properties remain poorly understood. In this work, we characterize conditional estimation bias in group-relative advantages among non-degenerate groups. For mean-centered advantages under binary rewards, our analysis shows negative conditional mean estimation errors for hard prompts and positive errors for easy prompts. At the response level, correct answers to hard prompts are underweighted, while incorrect answers to easy prompts receive insufficient penalties. translated_title: 你的组相对优势是有偏的
translated_abstract: 基于验证器奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为对大语言模型在推理任务上进行后训练的广泛使用的方法，其中GRPO及其变体等基于组的方法获得了广泛采用。这些方法依赖组相对优势估计来避免使用学习到的评论家，然而其理论性质仍鲜为人知。在这项工作中，我们刻画了非退化组中组相对优势的条件估计偏差。对于二元奖励下以均值为中心的优势估计，我们的分析表明：困难提示的条件均值估计误差为负，而简单提示的误差为正。在响应层面，困难提示的正确答案被低估了权重，而简单提示的错误答案受到的惩罚不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了历史感知自适应难度加权（HA-DW），一种能够调整优势估计的自适应重加权方案。
tldr: 本文揭示了GRPO等基于组的强化学习方法中组相对优势估计存在条件偏差——困难提示的正确答案被低估、简单提示的错误答案惩罚不足，并提出历史感知自适应难度加权（HA-DW）方案来解决该问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals conditional estimation bias in group-relative advantages for GRPO-style RL methods—correct answers to hard prompts are underweighted while incorrect answers to easy prompts are insufficiently penalized—and proposes History-Aware Adaptive Difficulty Weighting (HA-DW) to address it.
